questions.text: __________ निवेशक और डिपॉजिटरी के बीच मध्यस्थ के रूप में कार्य करता है और जो डीमेटीरियलाइज़्ड अंशों के खातों का रखरखाव करने के लिए अधिकृत है।
questions.text_english: ________ serves as an intermediary between the investor and the depository who is authorised to maintain the accounts of dematerialised shares.

options.A: डिपॉजिटरी प्रतिभागी
options.B: राष्ट्रीय प्रतिभूति डिपॉजिटरी लिमिटेड
options.C: केन्द्रीय डिपॉजिटरी सेवा लिमिटेड
options.D: स्टॉक एक्सचेंज

options_english.A: Depository Participant
options_english.C: Central Depository Services Limited
options_english.D: Stock Exchange

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Depository Participant. A Depository Participant (DP) acts as an intermediary between the investor and the depository (such as NSDL or CDSL). The DP is authorised to maintain accounts of dematerialised shares on behalf of investors. Options (B) NSDL and (C) CDSL are themselves depositories, not intermediaries between investors and the depository. Option (D) Stock Exchange is a platform for trading securities and does not maintain demat accounts.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) डिपॉजिटरी प्रतिभागी है। डिपॉजिटरी प्रतिभागी निवेशक और डिपॉजिटरी के बीच मध्यस्थ के रूप में कार्य करता है और डीमैट खातों का रखरखाव करता है। NSDL और CDSL स्वयं डिपॉजिटरी हैं, मध्यस्थ नहीं। स्टॉक एक्सचेंज प्रतिभूतियों के व्यापार का मंच है।

questions.text: रक्षा-बंधन पर रीना को अपने भाई से एक उपहार मिला। उपहार (गिफ्ट) लपेटने का कागज़ हटाने के बाद उसने देखा कि उसमें एक सजावटी कार्डबोर्ड का डिब्बा है। डिब्बे के अंदर उसे एक छोटी काँच की बोतल में महँगी फेस क्रीम मिली। सजावटी कार्डबोर्ड के डिब्बे व काँच की बोतल दोनों पर बहुत सुंदर लेबल लगा था, जिस पर ब्रांड का नाम, सामग्री, समाप्ति तिथि इत्यादि प्रदर्शित थे। काँच की बोतल पैकेजिंग के किस स्तर को दर्शाती है?
questions.text_english: On Raksha Bandhan, Reena received a gift from her brother. After removing the gift wrap paper, she saw a decorative cardboard box. Inside the box, she found a small glass bottle containing an expensive face cream. Both the decorative cardboard box and the glass bottle had a beautiful label displaying the brand name, ingredients, expiry date, etc. Which level of packaging does the glass bottle represent?

options.A: प्राथमिक पैकेजिंग
options.B: परिवहन पैकेजिंग
options.C: द्वितीयक पैकेजिंग
options.D: सामान्य पैकेजिंग

options_english.A: Primary packaging
options_english.C: Secondary packaging
options_english.D: General packaging

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Primary packaging. The glass bottle is the immediate container that directly holds the face cream and comes into direct contact with the product. This is called primary packaging. The decorative cardboard box surrounding the glass bottle is secondary packaging. Transportation packaging refers to large containers used during transit. Option (D) General packaging is not a standard term in marketing.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) प्राथमिक पैकेजिंग है। काँच की बोतल उत्पाद (फेस क्रीम) के सीधे संपर्क में आने वाली तत्काल पैकेजिंग है, इसलिए यह प्राथमिक पैकेजिंग है। सजावटी कार्डबोर्ड का डिब्बा द्वितीयक पैकेजिंग है।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R)।
अभिकथन (A): डीमैट रूप में अंशों को रखना अधिक सुविधाजनक है क्योंकि यह बिल्कुल एक बैंक खाते की तरह है।
कारण (R): भारतीय प्रतिभूति और विनिमय बोर्ड (सेबी) ने निपटान कार्यविधि को डीमैट रूप में करना अनिवार्य कर दिया है।
निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements: Assertion (A) and Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Holding shares in demat form is very convenient as it is just like a bank account.
Reason (R): Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has made it mandatory for the settlement procedures to take place in demat form.
Choose the correct alternative from the following:

options.A: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है तथा कारण (R) सत्य है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों असत्य हैं।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, परंतु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।

options_english.A: Assertion (A) is false and Reason (R) is true.
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are false.
options_english.C: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.D: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C). Both the Assertion and the Reason are true statements. Holding shares in demat form is indeed convenient like a bank account (A is true), and SEBI has indeed mandated settlement in demat form (R is true). However, the reason does not correctly explain the assertion. The convenience of demat form (like a bank account) is due to its features such as easy transfer, no risk of physical damage, etc. — not because SEBI made settlement mandatory. Therefore, both are true but R does not explain A.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है। दोनों कथन सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता। डीमैट खाते की सुविधा उसकी विशेषताओं के कारण है, सेबी के आदेश के कारण नहीं।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए:
कथन I: व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण में सामान्य और विशिष्ट दोनों प्रकार की शक्तियाँ सम्मिलित हैं।
कथन II: विशिष्ट शक्तियों का प्रभाव सभी व्यावसायिक उद्यमों पर पड़ता है और इसलिए वह किसी व्यक्तिगत फर्म को केवल अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से ही प्रभावित कर सकती हैं।
दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully:
Statement I: Business environment includes both specific and general forces.
Statement II: Specific forces have an impact on all business enterprises and thus may affect an individual firm only indirectly.
In light of the given statements, choose the correct alternative from the following:

options.A: कथन I सत्य है तथा कथन II असत्य है।
options.B: कथन I असत्य है तथा कथन II सत्य है।
options.C: कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों सत्य हैं।
options.D: कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों असत्य हैं।

options_english.A: Statement I is true and Statement II is false.
options_english.B: Statement I is false and Statement II is true.
options_english.C: Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
options_english.D: Both Statement I and Statement II are false.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A). Statement I is true — business environment does include both general forces (economic, social, legal, technological, political) and specific forces (suppliers, customers, competitors, etc.). Statement II is false — it is the general forces that affect all business enterprises and may affect individual firms indirectly. Specific forces, on the contrary, directly affect specific firms or industries. So Statement II has incorrectly described the characteristic of general forces as specific forces.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। कथन I सत्य है। कथन II असत्य है — सामान्य शक्तियाँ सभी उद्यमों को प्रभावित करती हैं और किसी फर्म को अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से प्रभावित कर सकती हैं, न कि विशिष्ट शक्तियाँ।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से कथन कर्मचारियों को प्रशिक्षण देने पर संगठन को होने वाले लाभों के संदर्भ में सही हैं?
(i) प्रशिक्षण भविष्य के प्रबंधकों को तैयार करने का कार्य करता है जो आकस्मिक संकट (आपातकाल) के समय स्थिति संभाल सकें।
(ii) प्रशिक्षण, कर्मचारियों को अधिक कुशल बनाता है ताकि वह मशीनों को कुशलतापूर्वक संभाल सकें और इस प्रकार उनकी दुर्घटना की संभावना भी कम हो जाती है।
(iii) प्रशिक्षण कर्मचारियों में संतोष तथा मनोबल बढ़ाता है।
(iv) प्रशिक्षण कर्मचारियों की उत्पादकता में दोनों प्रकार से – मात्रात्मक व गुणवत्तापूर्ण वृद्धि करता है, जिससे लाभ में वृद्धि होती है।
questions.text_english:
Which of the following statements are correct with respect to the benefits the organisation would get by imparting training to its employees?
(i) Training equips the future manager who can take over in case of an emergency.
(ii) Training makes an employee more efficient to handle machines and thus, they are less prone to accidents.
(iii) Training increases the satisfaction and morale of the employees.
(iv) Training enhances employee productivity, both in terms of quantity and quality, leading to higher profits.

options.A: (i), (ii), (iii) और (iv)
options.B: (ii) और (iii)
options.C: (i) और (iv)
options.D: (i) और (ii)

options_english.A: (i), (ii), (iii) and (iv)
options_english.C: (i) and (iv)
options_english.D: (i) and (ii)

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) — all four statements are correct benefits of training to the organisation. Training (i) prepares future managers who can handle emergencies, (ii) makes employees skilled to handle machines reducing accident risk, (iii) improves employee satisfaction and morale, and (iv) enhances productivity in both quantity and quality, leading to higher profits. All four are genuine organisational benefits of training, making option (A) the correct choice.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। चारों कथन सही हैं और ये सभी संगठन को प्रशिक्षण देने के लाभ हैं।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक संगठन के प्रभागीय ढाँचे का लाभ नहीं है?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is not an advantage of divisional structure of an organisation?

options.A: यह प्रभागीय अध्यक्ष में विभिन्न कौशलों का विकास कर उसे उच्च पदों पर पदोन्नति के लिए तैयार करता है।
options.B: प्रत्येक प्रभाग स्वायत्त इकाई होने के कारण इसमें लचीलेपन व पहल को प्रोत्साहन मिलता है जिससे शीघ्र निर्णयन में मदद मिलती है।
options.C: यह विस्तार एवं विकास को सुगम बनाता है क्योंकि वर्तमान गतिविधियों में बाधा डाले बिना नया प्रभाग जोड़ा जा सकता है।
options.D: इसमें प्रयासों की कम-से-कम पुनरावृत्ति होती है जिसके परिणामस्वरूप बड़े पैमाने पर कार्य के लाभ होते हैं व लागत में कमी आती है।

options_english.A: It helps in development of varied skills in the divisional head which prepares him for higher positions.
options_english.B: It promotes flexibility and initiative, because each division functions as an autonomous unit, leading to faster decision making.
options_english.C: It facilitates expansion and growth as new divisions can be added without interrupting the existing operations.
options_english.D: It leads to minimal duplication of effort which results in economies of scale and lowers cost.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D). In a divisional structure, each division has its own set of functions (HR, Finance, Marketing, etc.), which actually leads to duplication of resources and efforts rather than minimising it. This is in fact a disadvantage of divisional structure, not an advantage. Options (A), (B), and (C) are all genuine advantages of divisional structure — it develops managerial skills, promotes autonomy and quick decision-making, and facilitates growth.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है। प्रभागीय ढाँचे में प्रत्येक प्रभाग के अपने कार्य होते हैं जिससे प्रयासों की पुनरावृत्ति होती है — यह इसका दोष है, लाभ नहीं।

questions.text: नीचे दिए गए चित्र से, उस उत्तरदायित्व को पहचानिए जिसका निर्वहन उपभोक्ता 'खाने के लिए तैयार पास्ता' को खरीदते समय कर रहा है:
questions.text_english: From the picture given below, identify the responsibility that the consumer is fulfilling while purchasing 'Ready-to-Eat Pasta':

options.A: बाज़ार में उपलब्ध विभिन्न वस्तुओं एवं सेवाओं के संबंध में जानकारी रखें जिससे बुद्धिमत्तापूर्ण व विवेकशील चयन किया जा सके।
options.B: यह पक्का करने के लिए कि आपको सही सौदा मिले दृढ़ता का परिचय दें।
options.C: लेबल को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें तथा मूल्य, शुद्ध भार, उत्पादन एवं उपयोग-योग्य अंतिम तिथि आदि के बारे में जानें।
options.D: वस्तुओं या सेवाओं की खरीद पर नगद रसीद माँगें।

options_english.A: Be aware about various goods and services available in the market so that an intelligent and wise choice can be made.
options_english.B: Assert yourself to ensure that you get a fair deal.
options_english.C: Read labels carefully so as to have information about prices, net weight, manufacturing and expiry dates, etc.
options_english.D: Ask for a cash memo on purchase of goods or services.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C). The picture shows a consumer carefully reading the nutrition label on a ready-to-eat pasta container. This reflects the consumer responsibility of reading labels carefully to gain information about prices, net weight, manufacturing date, and expiry date. This is a consumer responsibility — not a right — because it is the duty of the consumer to be informed about the product before purchasing. Options (A), (B), and (D) do not relate to the action shown in the image.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है। चित्र में उपभोक्ता पास्ता के डिब्बे पर लेबल पढ़ रहा है, जो कि उसके उत्तरदायित्व को दर्शाता है।

questions.text: 'गामा लिमिटेड', जिसकी अत्याधुनिक विनिर्माण इकाई करनेशा में स्थित है, भारतीय बाज़ार के लिए स्मार्टफोन का उत्पादन करती है। तेजी से हो रहे तकनीकी सुधार, बदलती उपभोक्ता पसंद और बाज़ार में आने वाले नए-नए प्रतिस्पर्धी कंपनी को अपनी योजनाओं में बार-बार सुधार के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं। यह व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण की किस विशेषता को दर्शाता है?
questions.text_english: 'Gamma Ltd.', with its state-of-the-art manufacturing set-up in Karnesha, produces smartphones for the Indian market. Rapid technological improvements, changing consumer preferences and the entry of new competitors in the market push the company to revise its plans frequently. This reflects which characteristic of business environment?

options.A: आंतरिक संबंध
options.B: गतिशील प्रकृति
options.C: जटिलता
options.D: तुलनात्मकता

options_english.A: Inter-relatedness
options_english.C: Complexity
options_english.D: Relativity

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Dynamic nature. The business environment is dynamic because it keeps changing constantly. Rapid technological changes, shifting consumer preferences, and new competitor entries are all examples of how the environment changes continuously, forcing the company to revise its plans frequently. This is the hallmark of a dynamic business environment. Inter-relatedness refers to different forces affecting each other; Complexity refers to numerous interacting forces; Relativity refers to environment being relative to location or context.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) गतिशील प्रकृति है। तेजी से बदलती प्रौद्योगिकी, उपभोक्ता पसंद और प्रतिस्पर्धा व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण की गतिशील प्रकृति को दर्शाते हैं।

questions.text: बच्चों के कपड़े बनाने वाली 'राधे टेक्सटाइल्स' व गृह सज्जा संबंधी सामान बनाने वाली 'घनश्याम गारमेंट्स' एक ही औद्योगिक क्षेत्र में काम करती हैं। दोनों कंपनियों ने मिलकर एक साझा रँगाई व परिष्करण संयंत्र स्थापित किया है। ऐसा इसलिए था, क्योंकि दोनों में से किसी के भी परिचालन का स्तर इतना बड़ा नहीं था कि वे संयंत्र की पूरी क्षमता का प्रयोग कर पाते। संयंत्र का संयुक्त रूप से उपयोग करने के साथ प्रत्येक कंपनी के लिए अब स्थायी पूँजी की आवश्यकता होगी:
questions.text_english: 'Radhe Textiles', a children's garment manufacturing business, and Ghanshyam Garments, a home furnishing manufacturing business operate in the same industrial area. Both companies jointly set up a common dyeing and finishing plant. This was because the scale of operations of each of them was not sufficient to make full use of the plant. With both of them jointly using the plant, the requirement of fixed capital for each company will now be:

options.A: पहले से अधिक
options.B: पहले से कम
options.C: पहले के समान
options.D: शून्य

options_english.A: Higher than earlier
options_english.C: Same as earlier
options_english.D: Nil

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Lower than earlier. Since both Radhe Textiles and Ghanshyam Garments are jointly sharing the cost of the dyeing and finishing plant, the fixed capital requirement for each individual company is now lower than it would have been if each had set up its own plant. Sharing a plant means the capital investment is divided, reducing the fixed capital burden on each company. This is a key benefit of resource-sharing arrangements.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) पहले से कम है। दोनों कंपनियाँ मिलकर संयंत्र की लागत साझा कर रही हैं, इसलिए प्रत्येक के लिए स्थायी पूँजी की आवश्यकता कम हो जाती है।

questions.text:
'आरएवीएल' एक एलईडी बल्ब बनाने वाली कंपनी है। उत्पादन की कुशलता सुनिश्चित करने के लिए, श्रमिकों को मासिक लक्ष्य दिए जाते हैं। अक्टूबर 2025 के माह में, श्रमिकों को 8,000 बल्ब बनाने का लक्ष्य दिया गया। महीने के अंत में, यह पता चला कि वास्तविक उत्पादन केवल 6,000 बल्ब था। जाँच के बाद, यह पता चला कि प्रशिक्षित श्रमिकों की कमी के कारण लक्ष्य प्राप्त नहीं हो पाया। इस समस्या को हल करने के लिए, उत्पादन प्रबंधक ने श्रमिकों के लिए प्रशिक्षण कार्यक्रम की व्यवस्था की तथा साथ ही अतिरिक्त श्रमिकों की भी भर्ती की।
प्रशिक्षित श्रमिकों की कमी की समस्या को हल करने के लिए उत्पादन प्रबंधक द्वारा नियंत्रण प्रक्रिया के किस चरण का अनुसरण किया गया?
questions.text_english:
'RAVL' is a company manufacturing LED bulbs. To ensure efficiency in production, the workers are given monthly targets. For the month of October 2025, the workers were given a target to produce 8,000 bulbs. At the end of the month, it was found that actual production was only 6,000 bulbs. After investigation, it was found that the target was not met due to shortage of trained workers. To resolve the problem, the Production Manager arranged training programmes for workers and also hired additional workers.
Which step of the controlling process was followed by the Production Manager to resolve the problem of shortage of trained workers?

options.A: निष्पादन मानकों का निर्धारण
options.B: वास्तविक निष्पादन की माप
options.C: वास्तविक निष्पादन की मानकों से तुलना
options.D: सुधारात्मक कार्यवाही करना

options_english.A: Setting performance standards
options_english.C: Comparing actual performance with standards
options_english.D: Taking corrective action

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Taking corrective action. The controlling process involves: setting standards, measuring actual performance, comparing actual with standards, and taking corrective action. In this case, the Production Manager had already identified the deviation (only 6,000 bulbs produced against 8,000 target) and its cause (shortage of trained workers). The step of arranging training programmes and hiring additional workers is the last step — taking corrective action to bridge the gap between actual and desired performance.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) सुधारात्मक कार्यवाही करना है। विचलन का कारण पता चल जाने के बाद, प्रशिक्षण कार्यक्रम आयोजित करना और नए श्रमिकों की भर्ती करना सुधारात्मक कार्यवाही का उदाहरण है।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी भर्ती के आंतरिक स्रोतों की सीमा नहीं है?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is not a limitation of internal sources of recruitment?

options.A: यह संगठन में नई प्रतिभाओं के प्रवेश के अवसरों को कम करता है।
options.B: कर्मचारी अकर्मण्य हो सकते हैं यदि वे समयबद्ध पदोन्नति के लिए आश्वस्त हैं।
options.C: इससे मौजूदा कर्मचारियों में असंतोष तथा निराशा हो सकती है, क्योंकि उन्हें लग सकता है कि उनकी पदोन्नति की संभावना कम हो गई है।
options.D: कर्मचारियों के बीच प्रतिस्पर्धा की भावना बाधित हो सकती है।

options_english.A: It reduces the scope of induction of fresh talent in the organization.
options_english.B: The employees may become lethargic if they are sure of time-bound promotions.
options_english.C: It may lead to dissatisfaction and frustration among existing employees as they may feel that their chances of promotion are reduced.
options_english.D: The spirit of competition among the employees may be hampered.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C). Option (C) describes a limitation that is actually associated with external recruitment, not internal recruitment. When recruitment is done from external sources, existing employees may feel that their promotion chances are reduced, leading to frustration. In internal recruitment, existing employees are given preference for promotions, so this situation does not arise. Options (A), (B), and (D) are all genuine limitations of internal sources of recruitment.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है। (C) में वर्णित स्थिति बाह्य भर्ती की सीमा है, न कि आंतरिक स्रोतों की। आंतरिक भर्ती में मौजूदा कर्मचारियों को प्राथमिकता दी जाती है।

questions.text:
'प्रबंधक अपनी टीम को इस प्रकार से प्रोत्साहित करता है एवं उसका नेतृत्व करता है कि प्रत्येक सदस्य संगठन के उद्देश्यों में योगदान देते हुए व्यक्तिगत उद्देश्यों को प्राप्त करने में सक्षम हो।'
उपर्युक्त में प्रबन्ध के महत्त्व के जिस बिन्दु पर प्रकाश डाला गया है, वह है:
questions.text_english:
'A manager motivates and leads his team in such a manner that individual members are able to achieve personal goals while contributing to the organisational objective.'
The point of importance of management highlighted above is:

options.A: प्रबन्ध सामूहिक लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करने में सहायक होता है
options.B: प्रबन्ध क्षमता में वृद्धि करने में सहायक होता है
options.C: प्रबन्ध व्यक्तिगत उद्देश्यों की प्राप्ति में सहायक होता है
options.D: प्रबन्ध समाज के विकास में सहायक होता है

options_english.A: Management helps in achieving group goals
options_english.C: Management helps in achieving personal objectives
options_english.D: Management helps in the development of society

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Management helps in achieving personal objectives. The statement specifically highlights that through motivation and leadership, individual members are enabled to achieve their personal goals while also contributing to organisational objectives. This directly corresponds to the importance of management in helping individuals achieve their personal goals. Option (A) refers to group goals only; (B) relates to efficiency; (D) relates to societal development — none of which is the primary focus of the given statement.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है। कथन में यह बताया गया है कि प्रबंधक प्रत्येक सदस्य को व्यक्तिगत उद्देश्य प्राप्त करने में सक्षम बनाता है — यह प्रबन्ध का महत्त्व 'व्यक्तिगत उद्देश्यों की प्राप्ति में सहायक' को दर्शाता है।

questions.text: कॉलम-I में दिए गए संगठन प्रक्रिया के चरणों का मिलान कॉलम-II में दिए गए इसके विवरण से कीजिए:
questions.text_english:
Match the step of the process of organising given in Column-I with its explanation given in Column-II:
Choose the correct option from the following :
questions.instruction_line: निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
questions.instruction_line_english: Choose the correct option from the following:

questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है: 1-(iv), 2-(i), 3-(ii), 4-(iii)। विभागीकरण = समान क्रियाओं का समूहन; अधिकार संबंध = आदेश की श्रृंखला; कार्य विभाजन = प्रबंध योग्य भागों में बाँटना; कर्तव्य निर्धारण = कौशल के अनुसार कार्य।

questions.text: वह बाज़ार जहाँ विद्यमान प्रतिभूतियों का व्यापार होता है, जाना जाता है:
questions.text_english: The market where existing securities are traded is known as:

options.A: प्राथमिक एवं द्वितीयक बाज़ार दोनों
options.B: प्राथमिक बाज़ार
options.C: द्वितीयक बाज़ार
options.D: मुद्रा बाज़ार

options_english.A: Both Primary and Secondary Market
options_english.C: Secondary Market
options_english.D: Money Market

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Secondary Market. The secondary market, also known as the stock exchange, is where existing (already issued) securities are bought and sold among investors. The primary market is where new securities are issued for the first time. The money market deals in short-term debt instruments. Therefore, the market for trading in already-issued securities is specifically the secondary market.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) द्वितीयक बाज़ार है। द्वितीयक बाज़ार (स्टॉक एक्सचेंज) में पहले से जारी प्रतिभूतियों का क्रय-विक्रय होता है। प्राथमिक बाज़ार में नई प्रतिभूतियाँ जारी होती हैं।

questions.text: किसी कंपनी की ब्याज और करों से पहले की आय अपने ब्याज भुगतान दायित्वों को कितनी बार पूरा कर सकती है, को जाना जाता है:
questions.text_english: The number of times earnings before interest and taxes of a company cover the interest obligation is referred to as:

options.A: पूँजी ढाँचा
options.B: वित्तीय उत्तोलक
options.C: ब्याज आवरण अनुपात
options.D: ऋण-सेवा आवरण अनुपात

options_english.A: Capital structure
options_english.C: Interest Coverage Ratio
options_english.D: Debt-Service Coverage Ratio

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Interest Coverage Ratio. The Interest Coverage Ratio measures how many times a company's Earnings Before Interest and Taxes (EBIT) can cover its interest payment obligations. It is calculated as EBIT divided by Interest Expense. Capital structure refers to the mix of debt and equity; Financial leverage refers to the use of debt to amplify returns; Debt-Service Coverage Ratio covers both interest and principal repayments.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) ब्याज आवरण अनुपात है। यह अनुपात बताता है कि EBIT अपने ब्याज भुगतान को कितनी बार पूरा कर सकती है। इसकी गणना EBIT / ब्याज व्यय से होती है।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R)।
अभिकथन (A): कार्यभार विश्लेषण तथा कार्यबल विश्लेषण मानवशक्ति आवश्यकताओं को समझने के लिए महत्त्वपूर्ण हैं।
कारण (R): यह संगठन को यह समझने में सहायता करता है कि कर्मचारियों की अधिकता है, कमी है या वह अनुकूलतम है।
निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements: Assertion (A) and Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Workload analysis and workforce analysis are important to understand the manpower requirements.
Reason (R): It helps the organization to know whether it is overstaffed, understaffed or optimally staffed.
Choose the correct alternative from the following:

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, परंतु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, परंतु कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, परंतु कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A). Both the Assertion and the Reason are true, and the Reason correctly explains the Assertion. Workload analysis determines the number of persons required to perform a given task in a given time, while workforce analysis shows the current number of people and their skills. Together, they help the organisation understand whether it is overstaffed, understaffed, or optimally staffed — which is exactly what the Reason states. Hence, R is the correct explanation of A.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। दोनों कथन सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है। कार्यभार और कार्यबल विश्लेषण यह जानने में मदद करते हैं कि संगठन में कर्मचारियों की अधिकता है, कमी है या वे अनुकूलतम हैं।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए:
कथन I: उच्च स्थायी प्रचालन लागत का परिणाम उच्च व्यावसायिक जोखिम होता है।
कथन II: यदि एक फर्म का व्यावसायिक जोखिम कम है, तो फर्म की ऋण उपयोग करने की क्षमता उच्च होती है।
दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully:
Statement I: Higher fixed operating costs result in higher business risk.
Statement II: If the firm's business risk is lower, the firm's capacity to use debt is higher.
In light of the given statements, choose the correct alternative from the following:

options.A: कथन I सत्य है तथा कथन II असत्य है।
options.B: कथन I असत्य है तथा कथन II सत्य है।
options.C: कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों सत्य हैं।
options.D: कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों असत्य हैं।

options_english.A: Statement I is true and Statement II is false.
options_english.B: Statement I is false and Statement II is true.
options_english.C: Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
options_english.D: Both Statement I and Statement II are false.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C). Both statements are true. Statement I is correct — higher fixed operating costs mean the firm has a high break-even point, making profits more sensitive to sales changes, which increases business risk. Statement II is also correct — when a firm's business risk is low (stable earnings), it has greater capacity to take on financial risk through debt, as it can reliably service interest obligations. Both concepts are fundamental principles of financial management.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है। दोनों कथन सत्य हैं। उच्च स्थायी लागत से व्यावसायिक जोखिम बढ़ता है और कम व्यावसायिक जोखिम वाली फर्म अधिक ऋण उपयोग कर सकती है।

questions.text:
शिखा, जो पहली बार निवेश कर रही थी, शेयर बाज़ार में निवेश करने को लेकर उत्साहित होने के साथ-साथ घबराई हुई भी थी, क्योंकि उसे लगा कि यह जोखिम भरा है। उसने अपनी सहेली, रमा, से सलाह ली, जो कि एक अनुभवी निवेशक थी। रमा ने शिखा को विश्वास दिलाया कि शेयर बाज़ार में निवेश करना सुरक्षित है क्योंकि स्टॉक एक्सचेंज की सदस्यता का नियमन भारतीय प्रतिभूति और विनिमय बोर्ड (सेबी) द्वारा किया जाता है। उसने शिखा को यह भी बताया कि सेबी निवेशकों के अधिकारों और हितों की रक्षा के लिए कई काम करता है।
रमा द्वारा बताए गए निम्नलिखित कार्यों में से कौन-सा सेबी का सुरक्षात्मक कार्य नहीं है?
questions.text_english:
Shikha, a first-time investor, was excited yet nervous about investing in the stock market as she felt it was risky. She sought guidance from her friend, Rama, who was an experienced investor. Rama assured Shikha that it is safe to invest in the stock market as the membership of stock exchange is regulated by Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI). She also told Shikha that SEBI performs various functions to protect the rights and interests of investors.
Which of the following functions mentioned by Rama is not a protective function of SEBI?

options.A: धोखेबाजी और अनुचित व्यापार प्रथाओं जैसे भ्रामक दावे वाले बयान, हेराफेरी, कीमतों में जान-बूझकर उलट-फेर आदि पर रोक लगाना।
options.B: अनुसंधान आयोजित करना तथा बाज़ार के सभी भागीदारों के लिए उपयोगी सूचनाओं का प्रकाशन करना।
options.C: आंतरिक व्यापार पर नियंत्रण तथा ऐसे व्यवहारों पर दंड लगाना।
options.D: प्रतिभूति बाज़ार में उचित आचरणों और आचार-संहिता को बढ़ावा देना।

options_english.A: Prohibition of fraudulent and unfair trade practices like making misleading statements, manipulations, price rigging, etc.
options_english.B: Conducting research and publishing information useful to all market participants.
options_english.C: Controlling insider trading and imposing penalties for such practices.
options_english.D: Promotion of fair practices and code of conduct in the securities market.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B). Conducting research and publishing information useful to all market participants is a developmental function of SEBI, not a protective function. SEBI's protective functions include prohibiting fraudulent practices, controlling insider trading, and promoting fair practices. The developmental functions include conducting research, publishing information, and training intermediaries. Options (A), (C), and (D) are all protective functions.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है। अनुसंधान आयोजित करना और सूचनाओं का प्रकाशन करना सेबी का विकासात्मक कार्य है, सुरक्षात्मक कार्य नहीं। (A), (C) और (D) सुरक्षात्मक कार्य हैं।

questions.text: 'ब्राइट एप्लाएन्सेस लिमिटेड' ने बाज़ार में ऊर्जा-कुशल वायुशुद्धिकरण यंत्रों की एक नई उत्पाद श्रृंखला शुरू करने की योजना बनाई। वायुशुद्धिकरण यंत्रों को सुचारू रूप से बाज़ार में उतारने के लिए कंपनी को पर्याप्त मात्रा में धन की आवश्यकता थी। इसके लिए वित्त प्रबंधक ने धन की आवश्यकता का अनुमान लगाकर उसे एकत्रित करने के लिए स्रोत निर्दिष्ट कर दिए जिनका उपयोग कंपनी को करना चाहिए। वित्त प्रबंधक द्वारा अपनाई गई प्रक्रिया कहलाती है:
questions.text_english: 'Bright Appliances Ltd.' plans to launch a new product line of energy-efficient air purifiers. To ensure a smooth launch of the air purifiers, the company needs to arrange adequate funds. For this, the Finance Manager estimates the fund requirements and specifies the source of funds the company should use. The process followed by the Finance Manager is called:

options.A: वित्तीय नियोजन
options.B: वित्तीय प्रबंधन
options.C: वित्तीय उत्तोलक
options.D: निवेश निर्णय

options_english.A: Financial planning
options_english.C: Financial leverage
options_english.D: Investment decision

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Financial planning. Financial planning involves estimating the fund requirements of a business and identifying the sources of funds. The Finance Manager has estimated how much money is needed for the new product launch and specified from where it should be raised — this is precisely what financial planning entails. Financial management is the broader concept; financial leverage refers to use of debt; investment decision refers to where funds are to be deployed.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) वित्तीय नियोजन है। वित्तीय नियोजन में धन की आवश्यकता का अनुमान लगाना और उसके स्रोत निर्धारित करना शामिल है।

questions.text:
'सुमी', एक सुप्रतिष्ठित घरेलू कार निर्माता कंपनी, देश में एक प्रीमियम विदेशी ऑटोमोबाइल ब्रांड के आने का पूर्वानुमान लगा रही है। कंपनी का प्रबंधन अपने उत्पाद के बाज़ार भाग, विशेषत: प्रीमियम खंड में कमी आने का पूर्वानुमान लगा रहा है। अपने बाज़ार भाग को बनाए रखने तथा प्रतिस्पर्धी बने रहने के लिए, कंपनी ने आक्रामक विज्ञापन करना शुरू कर दिया है तथा उत्पादन लागत को कम करने के लिए कदम उठाने शुरू कर दिए हैं। उन्होंने अपने उत्पाद की गुणवत्ता में सुधार करने, नई विशेषताओं को जोड़ने एवं अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मानकों के साथ अपनी कारों को लाने में पुन: निवेश किया है।

questions.text_english:
'Sumi', a well-established domestic car manufacturer, anticipates entry of a premium foreign automobile brand in the country. The management of the company foresees a decline in the market share, especially in the premium segment. To retain its market share and stay competitive, the company launches aggressive advertising and takes measures to reduce the cost of production. It further invests in improving product quality, introducing new features and aligning their cars with international standards.
The point of importance of business environment described above is:

options.A: यह तीव्रता से हो रहे परिवर्तनों का सामना करने में मदद करता है।
options.B: यह उपयोगी संसाधनों का दोहन करने में मदद करता है।
options.C: यह फर्म को अवसरों की पहचान करने तथा पहल करने के लाभ प्राप्त करने में सक्षम बनाता है।
options.D: यह फर्म के खतरों को पहचानने व समय से पहले चेतावनी में सहायता करता है।

options_english.A: It helps in coping with rapid changes.
options_english.B: It helps in tapping useful resources.
options_english.C: It enables a firm to identify opportunities and getting the first mover advantage.
options_english.D: It helps the firm to identify threats and early warning signals.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D). 'Sumi' has anticipated a threat — the entry of a premium foreign automobile brand — and proactively taken steps to counter it. This demonstrates that understanding the business environment helps a firm identify threats early and take timely corrective action (early warning signals). questions.text:
अदिति ने ऑनलाइन विक्रेता से ₹2,000 में एक तीव्र गति वाला ब्लेंडर खरीदा। जब उसने इसका प्रयोग सूप बनाने के लिए किया, तो इसमें से तेज़ आवाज़ आई। इसने ठीक से पीसा (ब्लेंड) भी नहीं और इसमें से एक अजीब-सी गंध आ रही थी... अदिति इस सबसे परेशान हो गई और उसने उपयुक्त उपभोक्ता अदालत में निर्माता के विरुद्ध शिकायत दर्ज करा दी।
यदि उपभोक्ता अदालत तीव्र गति वाले ब्लेंडर की खराबी से संतुष्ट हो जाता है, तो अदिति को उपलब्ध किन्हीं तीन राहतों का उल्लेख कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
Aditi purchased a high speed blender from an online retailer for ₹2,000. When she used it to prepare soup, it made a loud noise. It also failed to blend properly and emitted an unusual smell... Aditi was frustrated and filed a complaint against the manufacturer in the appropriate consumer court.
State any three reliefs available to Aditi if the consumer court is satisfied about the defect in the high speed blender.

key_points: Removal of defect in the goods
Replacement of the defective blender with a new one of similar description
Refund of the price paid (₹2,000)
Award of compensation for any loss or injury suffered
Discontinue the unfair trade practice and not repeat it

questions.solution: If the consumer court is satisfied about the defect in the blender, Aditi can receive the following reliefs under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. First, the manufacturer can be directed to remove the defect from the blender free of cost. Second, the court can order replacement of the defective blender with a new blender of the same description. Third, the court can order a refund of the price paid, i.e., ₹2,000, to Aditi. Additionally, the court may award compensation for any loss or injury suffered due to the defective product.
questions.solution_hindi: उपभोक्ता संरक्षण अधिनियम, 2019 के अंतर्गत, यदि उपभोक्ता अदालत खराबी से संतुष्ट हो जाती है, तो अदिति को निम्नलिखित राहतें उपलब्ध हैं: (1) ब्लेंडर में से खराबी दूर की जाए, (2) खराब ब्लेंडर की जगह नया ब्लेंडर दिया जाए, (3) ₹2,000 वापस किए जाएँ।

Public Relations (International market) — Managing public opinion and building a positive image for the product by disseminating information and building goodwill

questions.solution: KUL uses three different promotion tools in each market. In the international market, it uses Public Relations, by managing public opinion, disseminating information, and building a positive image and goodwill for its products. (ii) Customer support services

(b) Explain the following factors which affect the fixation of price of a product:

(ii) Marketing methods used

sub_questions.text: विपणन नियोजन

key_points: Marketing planning involves setting marketing objectives
Developing a plan to achieve those objectives
Includes product strategy, pricing strategy, distribution, and promotion plans

sub_questions.solution: Marketing planning refers to the process of setting marketing objectives and developing a comprehensive plan to achieve them. It involves deciding the marketing goals of the organisation, assessing the current marketing situation, and formulating strategies related to product, price, place, and promotion (the 4 Ps). For example, a company may plan to increase its market share by 10% by launching a new product variant. Marketing planning ensures that all marketing activities are coordinated and directed toward achieving organisational goals.

sub_questions.text: ग्राहक समर्थन सेवाएँ

key_points: After-sale services provided to customers
Includes maintenance, repair, complaint handling
Builds customer loyalty and satisfaction

sub_questions.solution: Customer support services refer to the after-sales services provided by a business to its customers to maintain their satisfaction and loyalty. These include services such as handling customer complaints, providing maintenance and repair services, offering product installation guidance, and responding to customer queries. Such services help in building long-term relationships with customers and enhancing brand reputation. For instance, a washing machine company providing free service visits for the first year is an example of customer support service.

sub_questions.text: बाज़ार में प्रतियोगिता की सीमा
sub_questions.text_english: Extent of competition in the market

key_points: Higher competition leads to lower prices
In monopoly, firm can charge higher prices
In competitive markets, prices are market-determined

sub_questions.solution: The extent of competition in the market significantly affects the price of a product. If there is intense competition, a firm may have to charge a lower price to attract customers, or at least match competitors' prices. In a monopoly market, the firm can set higher prices as there are no close substitutes. In oligopoly or perfectly competitive markets, pricing is heavily influenced by competitors. For example, if a new company enters the smartphone market, existing companies may reduce their prices to retain customers.

sub_questions.text: उपयोग में लाई गई विपणन पद्धतियाँ

key_points: Extensive distribution and advertising increase costs
These additional costs are recovered through higher prices
Companies using direct selling can charge lower prices

sub_questions.solution: The marketing methods used by a company directly affect the price of its product. If a company uses expensive marketing methods such as extensive advertising, attractive packaging, wide distribution networks, and intensive sales promotion, it incurs higher costs. These additional costs are then added to the product's price, resulting in a higher selling price. On the other hand, a company that sells directly to consumers without intermediaries can afford to charge lower prices. Thus, the choice of marketing strategy and methods influences the final price of the product.

questions.text_english:
(a) Distinguish between Capital Market and Money Market on the following basis:
(i) Investment outlay
(ii) Duration
(iii) Safety
OR

sub_questions.text: पूँजी बाज़ार व मुद्रा बाज़ार में अन्तर्भेद
sub_questions.text_english: Distinguish between Capital Market and Money Market

key_points: Investment outlay: Capital market requires larger investment; money market instruments can be purchased with smaller amounts
Duration: Capital market deals in long-term instruments (more than 1 year); money market deals in short-term instruments (less than 1 year)
Safety: Money market instruments are generally safer; capital market instruments carry higher risk

sub_questions.solution: Capital Market and Money Market differ on the following basis. With regard to investment outlay, instruments in the capital market (such as shares, debentures) typically require larger investment amounts, whereas money market instruments (like Treasury Bills, Commercial Paper) can be transacted in relatively smaller amounts. Regarding duration, the capital market deals in long-term funds where instruments have a maturity of more than one year, while the money market deals in short-term funds with maturity of up to one year. As for safety, money market instruments are generally considered safer because they are issued by creditworthy entities like government and banks, whereas capital market instruments carry higher risk due to price fluctuations and default risk.

sub_questions.text: प्राथमिक बाज़ार व द्वितीयक बाज़ार में तीन अंतर
sub_questions.text_english: Three differences between Primary Market and Secondary Market

key_points: Primary market deals in new securities; secondary market deals in existing securities
In primary market, funds flow from investors to companies; in secondary market, funds flow between investors
Primary market has no fixed geographical location; secondary market has a fixed location (stock exchange)

sub_questions.solution: Primary Market and Secondary Market differ in the following ways. First, the primary market deals in new securities being issued for the first time (IPO, FPO), whereas the secondary market deals in existing securities that have already been issued. Second, in the primary market, funds flow from investors directly to the company issuing securities, thereby providing fresh capital to the company. In the secondary market, funds flow from one investor to another, and the company receives no direct funds. Third, the primary market has no fixed geographical location as securities are issued through prospectus, direct allotment, etc., while the secondary market has a specific location — the stock exchange — where buyers and sellers meet through brokers.

key_points: Leadership involves influencing others — a leader influences followers to work willingly
Leadership is situational — a good leader adapts leadership style to the situation
Leadership requires followers — without followers there can be no leader

sub_questions.solution: Three features of leadership are as follows. First, leadership involves influencing others — a leader influences and guides subordinates to act in a desired manner. Leena was able to motivate workers who were avoiding responsibility by building a positive environment. Second, leadership is a continuous process — a leader continuously interacts with followers, as seen from Leena spending time on the shop floor every week rather than on a one-time basis. Leena observed the shop floor conditions first before deciding her approach, demonstrating situational awareness.

questions.text: राहुल, प्रिया, अमित और स्नेहा मित्र हैं। उन्होंने संयुक्त रूप से व्यवसाय शुरू करने का निर्णय लिया... राहुल, प्रिया, अमित और स्नेहा द्वारा चर्चित विपणन प्रबंध की अवधारणाओं को पहचानिए एवं उनका उल्लेख कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Rahul, Priya, Amit and Sneha were friends. They decided to start a business jointly... Identify and state the marketing management philosophies discussed by Rahul, Priya, Amit and Sneha.

key_points: Rahul — Production Concept: focus on large-scale production for affordability
Amit — Product Concept: focus on high quality with special features
Priya — Marketing Concept: identify customer needs first, then satisfy them
Sneha — Societal Marketing Concept: consider long-term social welfare along with consumer needs

questions.solution: The four friends have discussed four different marketing management philosophies. Rahul advocates the Production Concept, which holds that consumers prefer products that are widely available at affordable prices; hence, the focus should be on large-scale production to lower costs. Amit advocates the Product Concept, which holds that consumers favour products of superior quality with special features, so the focus should be on developing high-quality bottles with time markers and filters. Priya advocates the Marketing Concept, which holds that the key to achieving organisational goals lies in first identifying the needs of target customers and then satisfying them more effectively than competitors; she suggests personalised and need-based bottle designs. Sneha advocates the Societal Marketing Concept, which holds that the business should not only satisfy consumer needs but also consider long-term societal welfare; she recommends reusable eco-friendly bottles to serve both consumers and society.

sub_questions.text: संप्रेषण की चार मनोवैज्ञानिक बाधाएँ

key_points: Premature evaluation — judging the message before it is fully received
Lack of attention — receiver's mind is preoccupied
Loss by transmission — information distorted as it passes through multiple people
Distrust — lack of trust between sender and receiver

sub_questions.solution: Four psychological barriers to communication are as follows. First, premature evaluation occurs when the receiver evaluates the message before it is completely communicated, leading to misunderstanding. For example, a manager interrupting an employee mid-sentence and drawing conclusions too soon. Second, lack of attention is a major psychological barrier where the receiver's mind is occupied with other thoughts, causing important information to be missed or ignored. Third, loss by transmission and poor retention means that when a message passes through multiple people in a chain, each person may filter or distort it, resulting in the original message being lost or changed by the time it reaches the final recipient. Fourth, distrust between the communicating parties can create barriers. If the receiver does not trust the sender, he may not accept the message at face value and may interpret it negatively.

key_points: Finding competent personnel — ensures right person for right job
Improves performance — proper training develops skills
Optimum utilization of human resources — no over or under-staffing
Builds long-term relationships — through proper career planning and development

sub_questions.solution: Four points of importance of the staffing function of management are as follows. First, staffing helps in finding competent personnel, ensuring that the right person is placed in the right job at the right time, which contributes to organisational efficiency. Second, staffing improves organisational performance by selecting suitable candidates and providing them with proper training and development, which enhances their skills and productivity. Third, staffing ensures optimum utilisation of human resources by maintaining an appropriate number of employees — neither too many (overstaffing) nor too few (understaffing), thereby reducing labour costs and improving efficiency. Fourth, staffing contributes to building long-term relationships through career planning, promotions, and job satisfaction, leading to employee retention and lower turnover costs.

sub_questions.text: संगठनात्मक लक्ष्यों की निष्पत्ति

key_points: Controlling guides all activities toward organisational objectives
Helps detect deviations and take corrective action on time

sub_questions.solution: Controlling helps in accomplishing organisational goals by guiding and directing all activities toward the preset objectives. It keeps a check on actual performance and compares it with standards. Whenever a deviation is noticed, timely corrective action is taken to bring performance back on track. Without controlling, activities may drift away from goals, leading to failure. For example, if a sales target is not being met, controlling helps identify the problem early and allows management to take corrective steps such as increasing marketing efforts.

sub_questions.text: संसाधनों का कुशलतम उपयोग

key_points: Controlling ensures resources are used efficiently
Wastage and misuse are detected and prevented

sub_questions.solution: Controlling ensures that all organisational resources — human, financial, physical, and informational — are used in the most efficient manner. By setting performance standards and measuring actual usage, controlling identifies wastage, duplication of effort, and misuse of resources. For example, if a production department is consuming more raw material than the standard quantity, the controlling function will detect this variance and prompt management to investigate and eliminate the waste, thereby improving efficiency and reducing costs.

sub_questions.text: पद-प्रतिष्ठा

key_points: Status refers to rank/position in the organisation
Higher status comes with perks, authority, and recognition

sub_questions.solution: Status as a non-financial incentive refers to the social rank or position that an employee holds in the organisational hierarchy. A higher status brings with it privileges such as a larger office, a personal assistant, authority to make decisions, and recognition from peers and subordinates. Employees are motivated to perform better if they know that good performance will lead to promotion and higher status. For example, being promoted from 'Senior Executive' to 'Manager' provides status recognition that motivates the employee to continue performing well.

sub_questions.text: संगठनिक वातावरण

key_points: Organisational climate is the overall work environment and culture
Positive climate motivates employees to perform better

sub_questions.solution: Organisational climate refers to the overall quality of the work environment — the collective perceptions, attitudes, and values that characterise the organisation. A positive organisational climate includes open communication, mutual trust, respect, teamwork, and recognition of contributions. When employees feel that they work in a supportive and positive environment, they are more motivated, productive, and loyal to the organisation. For example, a company that encourages creativity, provides freedom to experiment, and appreciates employee contributions fosters a positive climate that acts as a powerful non-financial incentive.

Retained earnings — company distributed large portion as dividends, leaving limited retained funds
Access to capital market — strong reputation allows raising funds from capital market

questions.solution: Four factors affecting the dividend decision of Suruchi Textiles Ltd. are as follows. First, stability of earnings — the company has stable earnings, which has allowed it to pay regular dividends for seven years. A firm with stable earnings can follow a higher dividend policy with confidence. Second, shareholders' preferences — the company has a large number of shareholders who depend on dividends as a source of regular income. To maintain their trust and confidence, the company must pay at least a minimum dividend every year. Third, retained earnings — since the company distributed a major portion of its earnings as dividends in earlier years, it was left with limited retained funds for internal financing of its expansion. This shows that a high dividend policy reduces retained earnings available for future use. Fourth, access to the capital market — despite limited retained earnings, Suruchi Textiles Ltd. could raise funds from the capital market due to its strong reputation. A company with easy access to capital markets can afford to distribute higher dividends as it can raise funds externally when needed.

sub_questions.text: अनुशासन

key_points: Obedience to organisational rules and regulations
Requires good supervisors at all levels and fair agreements

sub_questions.solution: Discipline, as a principle of management given by Fayol, means that employees must obey and respect the rules and regulations of the organisation. It requires the presence of good supervisors at all levels, clear and fair agreements between management and employees, and the judicious application of penalties for violations. Fayol believed that discipline is essential for the smooth functioning of an organisation. However, he also emphasised that discipline flows from good leadership — a good supervisor can maintain discipline without harsh punishment by earning respect through fair treatment.

sub_questions.text: निर्देश की एकता

key_points: Each group of activities with same objective should have one head and one plan
Ensures coordinated effort toward common goals

sub_questions.solution: Unity of direction means that each group of activities having the same objective should be directed by one manager using one plan. In other words, there should be one head and one plan for a group of activities having the same objective. For example, all marketing activities should be under one marketing manager with a single marketing plan. This ensures that efforts are not duplicated, resources are not wasted, and all activities are directed toward the same goal. It is different from Unity of Command — while Unity of Command relates to an employee receiving orders from one boss, Unity of Direction is about all activities of the same type being under one plan.

sub_questions.text: समता

key_points: Managers should be kind and just to subordinates
Combination of kindness and justice

sub_questions.solution: Equity as a principle of management means that managers should be both kind and just to their subordinates. Fayol did not use equality in a strict legal sense but as a combination of justice and kindliness. Employees should be treated fairly — not harshly, not with favouritism. When employees are treated equitably, they feel motivated and loyal to the organisation. For example, a manager who assigns tasks without discrimination and evaluates performance fairly is practising the principle of equity. This creates a positive work environment and builds trust between management and employees.

sub_questions.text: प्रबंधकों को वास्तविकता का उपयोगी सूक्ष्मज्ञान प्रदान करना
sub_questions.text_english: Providing managers with useful insights into reality

key_points: Principles train managers to understand reality and improve managerial thinking
Help manage situations better based on past experience

sub_questions.solution: Principles of management provide managers with useful insights into real-life managerial situations. They help managers understand what causes certain outcomes and how various factors interact in an organisation. Rather than relying purely on trial and error, managers can apply tested principles to make better decisions. For example, applying the principle of division of work helps managers understand that specialisation improves efficiency. These insights prevent managers from making avoidable mistakes and improve the overall quality of decision-making.

sub_questions.text: वैज्ञानिक निर्णय

key_points: Principles replace rule of thumb with systematic scientific approach
Decisions are based on facts and logic rather than intuition

sub_questions.solution: Principles of management help managers make scientific and rational decisions by replacing rule of thumb and intuitive judgment with a systematic and objective approach. When a manager follows established principles, decisions are based on thorough analysis of facts rather than personal whims or guesswork. For example, a manager using the principle of unity of command will clearly define reporting relationships rather than arbitrarily assigning authority. Scientific decision-making reduces the risk of errors and ensures that decisions are consistent, logical, and oriented toward organisational goals.

sub_questions.text: बदलती पर्यावरण की आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करना

key_points: Principles are flexible and can be applied in changing conditions
Help managers adapt to new challenges

sub_questions.solution: Principles of management are flexible and not rigid — they can be adapted to meet the requirements of a changing business environment. As the social, economic, and technological environment evolves, management principles serve as guiding frameworks that help managers adapt effectively. For example, the principle of initiative encourages employees to take creative steps, which is increasingly important in today's fast-changing, innovation-driven environment. Principles thus equip managers to respond to new challenges such as globalisation, digital transformation, and changing workforce expectations.

sub_questions.text: नियोजन दृढ़ता उत्पन्न करता है

key_points: Once a plan is made, managers may feel bound to follow it
This reduces flexibility to respond to new situations

sub_questions.solution: Planning leads to rigidity because once a detailed plan has been formulated, managers and employees feel bound to follow it strictly. This inflexibility can be harmful when circumstances change and a different course of action would be more appropriate. For example, if a company has made a plan to sell only through retail outlets and an opportunity arises to partner with an online platform, rigid adherence to the original plan may cause the company to miss the opportunity. Planning thus limits the freedom to adapt to new developments and emerging opportunities or threats.

sub_questions.text: नियोजन परिवर्तनशील वातावरण में प्रभावी नहीं रहता
sub_questions.text_english: Planning may not work in a dynamic environment

key_points: Plans are based on future forecasts which may not hold true
In rapidly changing environments, plans become obsolete quickly

sub_questions.solution: Planning may not work effectively in a dynamic or rapidly changing environment because plans are made based on predictions about the future, and these predictions may prove incorrect. Factors such as sudden changes in government policy, unexpected economic downturns, rapid technological changes, or shifts in consumer preferences can render even the best-prepared plans ineffective. For example, a company's five-year production plan based on expected demand may become irrelevant if a new technology disrupts the entire industry. In such situations, the time and resources spent on planning may be wasted.

sub_questions.text: नियोजन में भारी लागत आती है

key_points: Planning requires significant time and financial resources
If benefits are less than costs, planning becomes uneconomical

sub_questions.solution: Planning involves significant costs — both in terms of time and money. The process of gathering information, analysing data, forecasting, consulting experts, and preparing detailed plans requires considerable resources. For small organisations or those with limited budgets, the cost of planning may outweigh its benefits. Moreover, managers spend a large amount of their time in planning activities, which could have been used in executing tasks. If the plan does not materialise as expected, the investment in planning is wasted. Therefore, planning can become an expensive exercise that may not always yield proportionate returns.

sub_questions.text: नियोजन निर्णयन को सरल बनाता है

key_points: Planning provides a framework for decision-making
Managers can select the best course of action from available alternatives

sub_questions.solution: Planning facilitates decision-making by providing managers with a clear set of goals and a framework for choosing among alternatives. When managers are aware of what the organisation aims to achieve and have identified the available courses of action, they can make decisions more quickly and rationally. Planning ensures that all decisions are aligned with the organisational objectives. For example, if a company has planned to target the youth segment, all subsequent decisions about advertising, product design, and distribution channels will be made consistently in line with this goal, reducing confusion and indecision.

sub_questions.text: नियोजन नियंत्रण के मानकों का निर्धारण करता है

key_points: Plans set performance standards against which actual results are compared
Controlling becomes meaningful only when there are preset standards

sub_questions.solution: Planning establishes performance standards that serve as benchmarks for the controlling function. When a plan specifies what is to be achieved — for example, producing 10,000 units per month or achieving a sales target of ₹50 lakhs — this becomes the standard against which actual performance is measured. The controlling function then compares actual results with these planned standards to identify deviations and take corrective action. Without planning, there would be no standards, and controlling would have no basis. Hence, planning and controlling are inseparable — planning gives direction and controlling ensures that the direction is maintained.

sub_questions.text: नियोजन, नव-प्रवर्तन विचारों को प्रोत्साहित करता है

key_points: Planning requires managers to think ahead and explore new approaches
Encourages creativity and innovation in finding the best course of action

sub_questions.solution: Planning promotes innovative and creative thinking because it requires managers to look ahead, anticipate problems, and explore new approaches. When managers engage in planning, they must think about multiple alternatives and evaluate which is most effective — this process stimulates creative thinking. For example, while planning for market expansion, a manager might come up with the innovative idea of using social media influencers instead of traditional advertising. Planning thus provides an organised platform for new ideas to emerge and be evaluated systematically, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within the organisation.
